content:
Maya: heading out for a ~90min drive tomorrow, want a tiny playlist + 1 short read rec. low-effort, good-for-sunroof vibes. throw a song + 1-sentence book rec.

Jon: Ooh — 'Electric Feel' (MGMT). Book: 'The Sense of an Ending' — compact, quietly unsettling. :sunglasses:

Sam: For a chill sunset stretch: 'Night Drive' — The xx. Book: 'The Ocean at the End of the Lane' — short and oddly enchanting.

Lex: @Maya If you want a narrative punch, try 'This Is How You Lose the Time War' — tiny, perfect for 90min. Song: 'Cherry Wine' (acoustic) for the mellow lane.

OpsBot: Heads up: parking lot gates by HQ are closing at 8pm tonight :rotating_light: (not that it affects roadtrip snacks but FYI)

Maya: love these. small poll: react with :one: for MGMT, :two: for The xx, :three: for Florence + the Machine (suggested by @Sam), :four: for acoustic. also drop a 1-line snack rec pls.

Sam: Snack rec: salted peanuts + dark chocolate. compact + energy. :+1:

Jon: Snack rec: cold mango slices in a zip bag. messy but cheering.

Riley: Song rec: 'Dog Days Are Over' (Florence) — instant energy boost. Book: 'The Remains of the Day' if you want something dense but still short.

Alex: If you want a tiny flow, here’s my 6-track loop I use: ```1. Electric Feel
2. Night Drive
3. Cherry Wine
4. Dog Days Are Over
5. Holocene
6. Motion Picture Soundtrack```

Maya: saving this playlist. thanks all :heart: grabbing snacks tonight, will report back which combo wins.
